releases.title: Buying works when you are signed in

items.title: Pay for photos and clips while signed in
items.body: A purchase made from a signed-in account was being refused before the payment prompt. It now goes through and your photos and clips unlock as normal.

releases.title: Buy photos and clips in the app

items.title: Pay with mobile money
items.body: Prices and the Buy button are now shown on Explore, so you can buy a photo or a clip and open the original right in the app.

releases.title: Explore is on the sign-in screen

items.title: Open Explore in one tap
items.body: Explore Photos and Clips now has its own card on the sign-in screen, and an Explore shortcut on Home and in the More menu once you are signed in.

items.title: A Saved tab in Explore
items.body: Tap the heart on any photo or clip, then open Saved in Explore to find everything you kept in one place.

items.title: A new way to browse
items.body: Explore shows photos and short video clips from Connekyt creators in a scrolling grid. Filter by category, watch a short preview of a clip and save what you like.

items.title: Open what you already bought
items.body: Tap I already bought this, enter the code from your receipt, and your photos and clips open inside the app, ready to save to your phone.

releases.title: Drag your photobook photos into order

items.title: Drag photos to reorder a photobook
items.body: When a client sends you a photobook to edit, hold a photo and drag it where it should go. Holding and then tapping the new spot still works too.

items.title: Photos you bought open in full
items.body: The full-size photos you bought now open from inside your photobook, while photos you have not bought stay as watermarked previews.

items.title: The welcome photos are framed the way they used to be
items.body: The first two welcome screens now show the whole person at the same size as before, instead of a tight, zoomed in crop.

releases.title: Photobooks from any album you can use

items.title: Make a photobook from event, free, purchased or content albums
items.body: Pick photos from any album you can use, choose a cover and send the book to the photographer. Paid photos you have not bought are never shown, and a book uses one photographer's photos.

items.title: Review a book and ask for changes
items.body: When your photographer sends a book back you can accept it or send it back with a note saying what to change. A clearer list and timeline show what happens next.

items.title: New pictures on the welcome screens
items.body: The first two welcome screens, Your Talent and Your Vision, now show brand new photos of a photographer and an event planner.

items.title: A slimmer Grow your store card
items.body: The Grow your store card on Home now takes less room. Your invite link and the explainer live on the Milestones screen, one tap away.

items.title: 6 months of access for every album
items.body: New albums, both event albums and photos you sell, now stay open for 6 months before they are archived, and you get a warning before that happens.

items.title: Restoring an archived album gives 6 months back
items.body: When you pay to restore an archived album, it now opens again for 6 months, and the restore screen tells you so before you pay.
